checks: A direct protected URL without a cookie reaches login without reading the private record
A valid-shaped provider response without an admin role cannot create a session
A verified admin receives a Secure, HttpOnly, Strict, admin-path cookie, not a browser-visible token
Verified non-PII scope cannot read customer rows or issue a private search upstream
An authorised empty page is distinct from disconnected and forbidden states
Upstream outage and malformed data fail closed; no raw error leaks and Retry re-reads
Authorised, missing product shows a distinct not-found state
Commands require explicit revisions/idempotency and a typed receipt; 409 and ambiguous 200 are not success
Revoking a session on an already-mounted editor blocks the next Server Action before mutation
Sign-out expires the browser session and requests server-side revocation
